## `neuro.float32Array.from`

Static method on `Float32Array`.

> Creates an array from an array-like or iterable object.

## Signatures

```ts
from(input: { arrayLike: ArrayLike<number>; prompt?: string }): Promise<Float32Array>
from(input: { arrayLike: ArrayLike<T>; mapfn?: (v: T; k: number) => number; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<Float32Array>
from(input: { elements: Iterable<number>; prompt?: string }): Promise<Float32Array>
from(input: { elements: Iterable<T>; mapfn?: (v: T; k: number) => number; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<Float32Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Float32Array.from` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
